correctness.rationale: For the positive unnormalized graph Laplacian of a clique K_n plus one leaf at its hub, decompose heat-kernel row differences into eigenmodes 1,n,n+1 (and zero). For pendant–hub, the difference transports positive mass from the leaf to the hub at distance one and ordinary clique vertices at distance two, yielding F_n(t)=2(n−1)/n e^(−t)−(n−2)/n e^{−(n+1)t}. The hub–ordinary edge has transport cost G_n(t)=2/n e^(−t)+(n−2)/n e^{−(n+1)t}, and ordinary–ordinary has e^{−nt}; F−G=2(n−2)/n(e^(−t)−e^{−(n+1)t})≥0 and F≥e^{−t}≥e^{−nt}. Optimizing F gives t_n=(1/n)log((n−2)(n+1)/(2(n−1))) for n≥4, M_n>1 and limit 2. Independent direct matrix exponentials and primal Wasserstein LP matched exact norms for n=2..9 at three nonzero times, including norming edge.
